use_case_summary: MapleQuarry is building an in-app assistant embedded in their SaaS product (React). They need low-latency streaming so responses appear token-by-token in the UI. Primary requirements are predictable latency (aim <150ms per token at p50), simple hosted API integration, and visibility into token-level cost. Short-term trial -> 7-day POC to validate perceived latency and streaming UX.
technical_requirements: streaming responses (SSE or websocket) with example React integration
p50 per-token service latency target: <150ms (measured from request receipt to token emission)
ability to pin model version for stability during POC
SAML SSO for admin console (later) and audit logs
